verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that OpenTofu encrypts state and plan files at rest, for both local storage and remote backends, and also supports terraform_remote_state [docs-9, docs-20]. The landing page shows AES-GCM as the encryption method [docs-19], and a community comment shows interest in the feature but no hands-on test [comm-10]. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that encrypted state is unreadable in practice, and evidence on key-provider and key-management details (KMS integration, key rotation).
